scope: Kiến trúc - Thiết kế nội ngoại thất
Thiết kế - Sáng tạo nghệ thuật

decisions.source: requirements only; no role inference from source industry
decisions.skills: professional, tools, technologies, languages; no soft skills
decisions.training: future training and interest alone excluded
decisions.products: named product does not imply parent; industry is routing only
decisions.owner_sales_q1: Include named accounting software for explicit used OR sold alternatives; preserve condition. Selling alone does not imply using.
decisions.owner_sales_q2: Explicit skill heading such as office IT governs named tool list; company/system inventory alone stays ambiguous.
decisions.owner_batch02_q1: Separate MISA HR from MISA accounting; preserve existing MISA code/name and prior results.
decisions.benefits: Insurance coverage/benefits and contract signing offered to applicants are not skills.
decisions.law_lists: Finite list components require explicit governed law header; degrees excluded.
decisions.generic_sector: Employment at a bank, law office or financial company does not prove every professional capability.
decisions.v3: Last systematic correction: explicit professional headings, finite English/abbreviated aliases, governed law lists, shared office-tool proficiency; sector/employer and software-purpose exclusions. Prior review rounds now development only.
decisions.owner_salary_payment: Payment alone does not imply payroll calculation.
decisions.owner_specific_technologies: Keep ASP.NET and PL/SQL separate; no implicit parent .NET/SQL.
decisions.license_to_driving: Owner allows explicit driving licenses/certificates -> corresponding car/motorcycle/forklift skill; no experience years or old/new license conversion; vehicle ownership alone excluded.
decisions.sector: No operational logistics inference from employer/degree or sales logistics alone.
decisions.standards: Named standards count only as applicant knowledge/experience; company certifications excluded.
decisions.parent_technology: No implicit programming/operation from generic PLC/CNC; no generic ISO from numbered standard alone.
decisions.education: Major, department or employer alone does not assert practical skills.
decisions.projects: Participation in projects does not imply management; software management purpose does not imply professional management.
decisions.construction: Quantity takeoff and named construction duties count; majors alone excluded; CAD/AutoCAD, SAP2000/SAP and specific design tools are distinct.
